_comment: Certified KPI definitions and parameters. build_gold.py loads them into ref.kpi_definition and ref.kpi_parameter; the semantic views read only those tables, so a parameter changes here and nowhere else.

kpis.name: Severe-defect time to review
kpis.definition: Hours from the capture of a keyframe with a confirmed severe defect to the moment an engineer reviews it, median and P90, for the risk-ranked worklist and for calendar (time-based) order on the same inspections.
kpis.formula: hours = (reviewed_at - captured_at) / 3600 per severe defect; median and P90 by order (risk, calendar) and business date
kpis.grain: severe defect x worklist order x business date

kpis.name: Integrity risk exposure
kpis.definition: Sum over assets of the equipment_risk probability of an integrity event within 30 days times the asset's criticality weight (A=3, B=2, C=1), by facility and business date. Assets the model abstains on (stuck sensor, unit mismatch, too few readings) count zero and are reported separately.
kpis.formula: exposure = SUM(p_event_30d * criticality_weight[criticality]) GROUP BY facility_id, business_date

kpis.name: Unstructured coverage
kpis.definition: Share of unstructured objects received (PDF, drawing, SEG-Y, LAS, video) that are both extracted (EXTRACTED or EXTRACTED_OCR) and linked to an asset_id by the asset master, by format and business date. Quarantined objects count in the denominator.
kpis.formula: coverage = COUNT(objects extracted AND linked) / COUNT(objects received) GROUP BY format, business_date
